problem: Selling a home is slow and uncertain; Ivy makes instant offers, refurbishes and resells via channel partners.
business_model: iBuying: buy, refurbish and resell homes (spread)

founders.name: Pritam Thakur
founders.background_notes: Previously ran a real estate project in India (YC page).

technical_complexity.rationale: Pricing model plus transaction data; main difficulty is capital and operations. From description only.

defensibility.rationale: Claims a transaction information system; not verified.

market_need_then: Company claims 850+ homes bought and sold and Rs 1,000 Cr+ in transactions (self-reported).

brand_strength.rationale: No brand sources read; site copy uses the line 'We commit. No backing out.'

outcome_analysis: Ivy Homes is Active with 80 people. Self-reported volume is substantial, but funding was not found, so the capital behind its inventory model is unknown.
